name: Study Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a letter of acceptance from a recognised South African school, university, or training institution.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission from a recognised South African institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires proof of sufficient funds for tuition and living costs, medical insurance, and medical/radiological reports.
requirements.fix_path: Provide bank statements, a scholarship award letter, and required medical clearances.

evidence_required.document: Letter of acceptance from the institution
Proof of funds and medical insurance
Medical and radiological reports, police clearance

outcome.duration_length: tied to programme length, renewed annually

sources.title: Legitimus -- Temporary Residence Visa South Africa 2026 Guide, describing the Study Visa category
